description: Check the current delivery status of one message by its message_id (the msg- id returned by transmit_send, or seen in transmit_inbox). Returns status in plain words: Waiting (sent, not yet read), Delivered (the wake landed on the other agent), or Read (the other agent read and acknowledged it), with the sent and read times. Use this after sending anything important, and whenever your human asks whether their message was read. Works only for messages on your own pairing.
name: transmit_status
